Q1: The prerequisite (#6667 merged into the default branch) is missing. How should this issue proceed?
Choices:
A. Wait. Keep this issue parked until #6667 is on the default branch, then continue as the plan says (D11 / Q27 A). (RECOMMENDED)
B. Close this issue now as not actionable. Pick up the work again after #6667 merges.
C. Rebuild `claude_run_selected`, `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY` and exit 76 in this issue without #6667. **Note:** this goes against plan decision D11 and will probably conflict with #6667 when it merges.
Q2: Once the prerequisite is met, how should the four phases (capacity tiers, `MEMORY_LEARNINGS`, `SOFT_ERROR_ANALYZER`, `JUDGE_INTERIM`) be delivered?
Choices:
A. Run them as an orchestrator project from the plan document, one PR per phase (plan D10). Close this issue with a reference to that tracking issue. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Do all four phases in this one standalone issue and one PR. **Note:** goes against D10 and is likely to run past the 60-minute implement budget.
C. Do only Phase 1 (capacity tiers) here, and file Phases 2–4 as separate standalone issues.
